title: Officina configuration
description: Generated from the Options classes of Sleepyshark.Officina.Core; see docs/configuration-settings.md.

$schema.description: The JSON Schema of the file, for editor completion. Files only.

formatVersion.description: The configuration format version. Unknown versions are rejected.

project.description: The project's identity, and values usable in placeholders.

name.description: The project's name. Usable in instructions as `{{project.name}}`.

values.description: Free-form text values. Usable in instructions as `{{project.values.<name>}}`.

apiKey.description: The provider's credential, as the name of a secret, which is read when it is used.

secret.description: The name of the secret, such as the environment variable that holds it. Required.

models.description: Model profiles, by name. Agents refer to them by name.

provider.description: The provider that serves this profile, by its name in `providers`. Required.

effort.description: Reasoning effort, such as `low`, `medium` or `high`. Unset uses the provider's default.

maxOutputTokens.description: The most tokens one reply may have. Unset uses the provider's default.

toolChoice.description: Whether the model may call tools.

settings.description: Any other setting the provider declares for the model, such as a temperature, as text.

extends.description: Another agent definition this one builds on: it inherits every setting it does not set itself. Files only.

description.description: What the agent is for. Usable in instructions as `{{agent.description}}`.

instructions.description: The agent's job. Only the application knows it, so it has no default. Placeholders may use the project and the agent only. Required.
examples: Extract the invoice number, date and total. Reply as JSON.

model.description: The name of the model profile the agent runs on. Required.

tools.description: The tool sets, by name in `toolSets`, whose tools the agent is offered. The same tools are offered whoever the caller is.

permissions.description: Narrows the caller's permissions for this agent's tool calls: a permission counts only if the caller holds it and it is listed here. Unset keeps the caller's.

maxParallelToolCalls.description: The most tool calls from one reply that run at the same time, when every tool called is safe to run in parallel.

tools.description: Tools, by the name the model sees.

source.description: Where the tool comes from: `extension:<id>` for a tool the application registers, or `provider:<name>` for a tool the model provider runs itself. Required.

kind.description: `write` for a tool that changes something. Unset uses the tool's declaration; a tool that declares itself `write` stays `write`.

permissions.description: Permissions the caller must hold to call the tool.

gates.description: The tool's own gates, by name in `gates`. They run after the gates for all tools.

gateExemption.description: Why a write tool needs no gate of its own. Every write tool needs gates or this reason.
examples: Writes only to a scratch folder.

approval.description: Whether each call needs a human's approval. Unset means `always` for irreversible tools, otherwise `never`. For approval by rule, give the tool a `builtin:require-approval` gate with a condition.

timeout.description: The longest one call may take, as `hh:mm:ss`.

maxAttempts.description: How many times a call is tried. Only timeouts and unavailable errors are retried, and irreversible tools never are.

maxResultLength.description: The most characters of a result that enter the conversation; the rest is cut off.

parallelSafe.description: Whether calls may run at the same time as other calls. Unset uses the tool's declaration; `true` cannot loosen a tool that declares itself unsafe. Irreversible tools never run in parallel.

irreversible.description: Whether the tool's effects cannot be undone. Such a tool is a write tool, is carried out at most once for the same run and arguments, and needs approval unless `approval` says otherwise.

reason.description: Why a provider tool is enabled. Required for `provider:` tools.

toolSets.description: Named groups of tools, by name in `tools`. Agents are offered tools by tool set.

gates.description: Gates, by name. Tools and policies refer to them by name.

use.description: What the gate runs: `builtin:require-approval` or `builtin:deny`, which act when `when` holds, or `extension:<id>` for a gate the application registers. Required.

when.description: For the built-in gates: the condition over the tool's arguments under which the gate acts. Unset means always.

field.description: The field a test reads: a dotted path with optional `[n]` indexes, such as `args.branch`.

is.description: Holds when the field equals this value. Numbers compare by value, and `true` and `false` match booleans.

in.description: Holds when the field equals one of these values.

gt.description: Holds when the field is a number greater than this.

gte.description: Holds when the field is a number greater than or equal to this.

lt.description: Holds when the field is a number less than this.

lte.description: Holds when the field is a number less than or equal to this.

exists.description: `true` holds when the field is present and not null; `false` when it is missing or null.

all.description: Holds when every one of these conditions holds.

policies.description: Permission rules, gates for all tools, and anonymous callers' permissions.

permissionRules.description: Permission rules, in order. The first that matches a call decides it; a call no rule matches goes on.

tool.description: The tool the rule applies to, by name in `tools`. Required.

when.description: The condition over the tool's arguments under which the rule matches, written as in `gates.<name>.when`. Unset matches every call.

field.description: The field a test reads: a dotted path with optional `[n]` indexes, such as `args.branch`.

is.description: Holds when the field equals this value. Numbers compare by value, and `true` and `false` match booleans.

in.description: Holds when the field equals one of these values.

gt.description: Holds when the field is a number greater than this.

gte.description: Holds when the field is a number greater than or equal to this.

lt.description: Holds when the field is a number less than this.

lte.description: Holds when the field is a number less than or equal to this.

exists.description: `true` holds when the field is present and not null; `false` when it is missing or null.

all.description: Holds when every one of these conditions holds.

any.description: Holds when at least one of these conditions holds.

not.description: Holds when this condition does not.

action.description: What a match decides: `allow`, `deny`, `ask` a human, or `route` to `to`.

reason.description: Why, as told to the model and the human.

to.description: For `route`: the agent, by name, that the turn is handed to.

gates.description: Gates, by name in `gates`, that run before every tool call, ahead of the tool's own gates.

anonymousPermissions.description: The permissions a caller without an identity holds.

budget.description: The run's budget. It can be high, but it cannot be removed or unlimited. Required. Live: the owner may change it during a run.

cost.description: The most the run may spend, in USD. Live: the owner may change it during a run.

time.description: The longest the run may take, as `hh:mm:ss` or `d.hh:mm:ss`. Live: the owner may change it during a run.

permissionMode.description: How tool calls that need permission are decided: `ask` the owner, `auto` by the rules, or `readOnly`. Live: the owner may change it during a run.

capabilities.description: Optional capabilities and their settings. All are off by default.

workspace.description: The git workspace: a working copy per agent, and an integration queue into the baseline. Off when unset.

protectedPaths.description: Paths agents cannot see or change, in addition to the fixed ones: `.git`, `**/.env*` and `.sof/**` are hidden, and `sof.json` and `sof.*.json` are read-only.

path.description: A glob relative to the workspace root, where `**` matches any number of folders. Required.

access.description: `hidden`: agents cannot see it at all; `readOnly`: they can read it but not change it.

keepWorkingCopies.description: Whether an agent's working copy is kept when its task ends, so the owner can look at it.
